        "Read all nine owned file diffs, changed browser and unit assertions/manifests, enclosing controller consumers, and exact accepted validation/prefs/UI ranges. Base validateSource defaults true; Thunderbird overrides it. Directory admission checks existence of any prefs.js/ImapMail/Mail/News candidate, not type, useful contents or per-item availability. Missing prefs.js now returns after initializing empty preference collections, permitting mail-only sources instead of failing on read. UI remains Boolean: valid sources enable all supported items; invalid sources clear/disable items, hide selection, display localized nothing-to-import text and disable Continue. The suggested per-item map is not adopted.",
        "Failure recovery also changes: showError disables the .before-progress Start Import button only when _inProgress was true, reenables Back and clears progress state; profile/address-book/calendar summary rebuilds reenable the button. Naming follows appSourceInvalid/appSourceItems/checkAccounts and existing Fluent family. No focus, keyboard, accessible tree, platform or rendered UI validation ran.",
        "New browser assertions directly check invalid-source message visible, item selection hidden and Continue disabled, then reverse those states after Back and a valid directory. No source import/test/build/lint ran.",
